notes.key_messages:
To maximise their chances of success on this paper, candidates should:
• ensure that they answer the question asked, especially in Section 3
• remember that on a reading paper, reading the questions is as important as reading the texts
• remember that the questions follow the order of the text.
notes.general_comments:
Candidates appeared to have sufficient time to complete the paper, and almost all candidates were
appropriately entered for the examination. In multiple-choice questions, when candidates change their mind
about an answer, it is important that they make it clear which tick is to be regarded as their final answer.
